acceptanceCriteria: Cypress visit/intercept/get references are checked with fixtures.
Anchored regexes are evaluated against map routes; unanchored ones stay labelled.
A retained run on an adopter-scale suite, with promotion recorded or declined with reason.
body: V1-1581 (PR #1052) added `corvint flows appmap refs` (AMAP-V0-090..099), experimental. Residuals: (1) Cypress cy.visit/cy.intercept/cy.get references and a configured Playwright testIdAttribute are not read; (2) unanchored regular expressions are treated as labelled path prefixes, not evaluated; (3) no qualification against a real adopter-scale Playwright suite; promotion out of experimental needs that evidence.
title: flows appmap refs: Cypress references, Playwright testIdAttribute, anchored regex evaluation, adopter-scale qualification (V1-1581 residuals)
